title: Template -- WinRM remote command execution (wsmprovhost child process)
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1021.006 (Remote Services: Windows Remote Management). Anything executed over WinRM on the receiving host is a child of wsmprovhost.exe, the WinRM provider host -- so the parent process, not the command line, is what identifies remote execution. That makes this a reliable lateral-movement signal on hosts where WinRM is not the sanctioned administration path, and near-useless noise on hosts where it is; scope by asset role before deploying. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
